About this product

The TP-Link VIGI NVR4032H is a 32-channel network video recorder designed for comprehensive surveillance systems. It provides high-capacity storage of up to 64 TB via four SATA drive bays (4× SATA, up to 16 TB each), accommodating extensive video archives. With support for dual 4K video output through HDMI and VGA ports, you can monitor high-resolution footage on multiple displays simultaneously. The NVR uses H.265+ video compression to reduce bandwidth usage and save storage space without sacrificing image quality.
